   - The type name `pan_bomap_hdr` has been removed from the internal struct definition. The struct is now defined anonymously, which means it no longer has a specific name.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The change in `panfrost_drm.h` is a reversion of a previous modification that had inadvertently added the type name back to the struct. This patch aims to restore the original design by removing the type name again, ensuring that the Panfrost UAPI header compiles correctly in C++. The modification is directly related to fixing the compilation issue introduced by the earlier commit (72655fb942c1).

drm/panfrost: Remove type name from internal struct again

Commit 72655fb942c1 ("drm/panfrost: replace endian-specific types with
native ones") accidentally reverted part of the parent commit
7228d9d79248 ("drm/panfrost: Remove type name from internal structs")
leading to the situation that the Panfrost UAPI header still doesn't
compile correctly in C++.

Revert the accidental revert and pass me a brown paper bag.

Reported-by: Alyssa Rosenzweig <alyssa@collabora.com>

The bug was caused by an accidental reintroduction of a type name in the internal struct definition in the Panfrost UAPI header, which conflicted with the requirements for C++ compilation.
